On Monday, July 9 WILLIAMS JEFFREY E sold $2.98 million worth of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) or 15,652 shares. Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) Rating Reaffirmed
The company has just set a target of $222 on Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) shares. This is 29.86 % from the last stock price. In a note shared with investors and clients on Thursday, 13 December, Piper Jaffray reconfirmed their “Overweight” rating on shares of AAPL. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) Ratings Coverage
Among 18 analysts covering Apple ( NASDAQ:AAPL ), 10 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 8 Hold. Therefore 56% are positive. Apple has $310 highest and $165 lowest target. $222.12’s average target is 29.93% above currents $170.95 stock price. Apple had 37 analyst reports since June 25, 2018 according to SRatingsIntel. The stock has “Hold” rating by HSBC on Tuesday, December 4. The firm has “Overweight” rating by Morgan Stanley given on Friday, December 7. On Friday, November 2 the stock rating was maintained by BMO Capital Markets with “Market Perform”. The rating was downgraded by Bank of America to “Neutral” on Friday, November 2. The rating was maintained by Morgan Stanley with “Overweight” on Thursday, November 8. The rating was maintained by Rosenblatt with “Neutral” on Thursday, December 6. The firm has “Overweight” rating by Morgan Stanley given on Tuesday, July 24. Bank of America maintained the stock with “Buy” rating in Tuesday, August 21 report. On Friday, November 2 the stock rating was maintained by Nomura with “Neutral”. The stock has “Buy” rating by Canaccord Genuity on Wednesday, August 1.
The stock increased 1.09% or $1.85 during the last trading session, reaching $170.95. About 31.67 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 0.17% since December 13, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 0.17% the S&P500.
Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on February, 7. They expect $4.74 EPS, up 21.85 % or $0.85 from last year’s $3.89 per share. AAPL’s profit will be $22.49 billion for 9.02 P/E if the $4.74 EPS becomes a reality. After $2.91 actual EPS reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 62.89 % EPS growth.
Apple Inc. designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players to consumers, small and mid-sized businesses, and education, enterprise, and government clients worldwide. The company has market cap of $811.23 billion. The firm also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. It has a 14.35 P/E ratio. It offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers.
